criteria.requirement: Repair asynchronous giveup and event callback adaptation to await any actual Awaitable result, including async __call__ instances and ordinary wrappers returning coroutine objects. Synchronous callbacks remain supported and are invoked exactly once; await results before deciding giveup and before completing the event. Preserve callback exception identity and prevent never-awaited warnings. Do not expand predicate or target APIs, change synchronous retry policy or swallow callback exceptions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
